title: Shared number
intro: One number that lives on the chain. Anyone can see it, anyone can change it, and every change is recorded.
steps: Pick who you are at the top right.
The big number on the left is the current value. The chart under it fills in as it changes.
Type a new number on the right and press Save. Then switch person and try again.

set.label: Change the number
set.help: Whatever you save replaces the old number for everybody.
